title: Midland and Manassas parties as spin-offs of Gibson's
summary: Max Christianson starts a Midland party in 1977 with some Odessa players, and Leeman notes other offshoots in New Jersey and Manassas, Virginia.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Another insert on the jazz parties, was one of our fans in the Odessa parties was a gentleman called Max Christianson from Midland, Texas -- of course, that's only 30 minutes away, about 30 or 40 miles from Odessa.

So two years ago in '77, he decided that they wanted a session over there in Midland, along the same lines, but with a few different musicians to add a little flavor, around November, which would be -- our parties in Odessa were in May, and that would be mid-year, so that would be six months apart, and he started his jazz sessions, his jazz party with the nucleus of some from the Odessa parties, but adding a few younger, more modern generation musicians to add a different flavor to the music, and I was asked to open that first party.

That has become an extremely successful party, too, and of course, as I said, the six month interval doesn't interfere with the Odessa party. I didn't get to say in the Odessa parties, and the guest lists, and also in the Midland parties for Max Christianson, the guest list included many people from all over the country in all walks of life, so that the clientele was not local in entirety, by any means, and

a lot of those people came after they learned of the parties that were regulars at the Gibson parties. So there is a great movement, jazz wise, as a throwoff on the original Gibson parties. We have the one down in Jersey now, and there is one every year down in Manassas, Virginia, which is sponsored by Fat Cat Johnson McCree - Johnson McCree.
And his parties aren't on such a large scale, but it gives many musicians who aren't quite so famous, along with a few famous ones, a chance to participate, and their list ... (CUT)
